a: – Ed sheyyetze min hakkodesh lachol.
Min hakkodesh lakkodesh, kegon: lakach kinne zavim, vekinne zavot, vekinne yoldot,
Veshakal shiklo, vehevi chattato vaashamo min hahekdesh – kevan shehotzi – maal, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: ad sheyyizrok haddam. minnayin? talmud lomar: "timol maal" – mikkol makom.
Amar mar: "nefesh" – echad hayyachid veechad hannasi veechad hammashuach bammashma. sheyyachol, may? peshita, "nefesh" ketiv!
Mahu detema, amar rachamana "vaasher yitten mimmennu al zar", vehay lav "zar" hu, deha immeshach begavvevy, ka mashma lan.
Veakkesha rachamana lesota, velaavoda zara, velitruma. lesota, deaf al gav delo pagam, gabbe hekdesh name, natna tabbaat beyadah – maala.
Ki akkesha rachamana laavoda zara, dead deit ba shinnuy, gabbe hekdesh name, ad devikka bekardom, veyifgom ufagum.
Akkesha rachamana litruma: ma teruma, "ki yochal" – perat lemazzik, gabbe hekdesh name – kol devar achila, ki mazzek leh – patur.
Ketzad? natna katla kulei. amar leh rav kahana lerav zevid: vedahava lav bar ippegome hu? veha dahava dechalleteh denun, lehecha azal?
Amar leh: dilma, dahava deramyayn kallataych hu. veod: nehi dela ikka nehena ufagam lealtar, leolam mi la ikka pegima?
Hannehene min hachattat vechulei. mikkede i bivhema temima, hayeynu kos shel zahav! amar rav pappa: bevaalat mum askinan.
b: Mishna nehena kevachatzi feruta ufagam kachatzi feruta, o shennehena beshave peruta bedavar echad ufagam beshave peruta bedavar acher – lo maal, ed sheyyehane beshave peruta veyifgom beshave peruta bedavar echad.

En moel achar moel bemukedashin ella behema ucheli sharet bilvad. ketzad? rachav al gabbe behema, uva chavero verachav, uva chavero verachav – kullan maalu. shata bechos shel zahav, uva chavero veshata, uva chavero veshata – kullan maalu. talash min hachattat, uva chavero vetalash, uva chavero vetalash – kullan maalu. rabbi omer: kol davar sheen lo pidyon – yesh bo moel achar moel.
Gemara manni? matnitin rabbi nechemya, hi: detanya en moel achar moel ella bivhema bilvad. rabbi nechemya omer: behema ucheli sharet.
May tama detanna kamma? kasavar: beinyayna divhema ketiv, dichtiv beel haasham.
Verabbi nechemya, amar lach: kal vachomer: im acherim mevi likdushshatan, hu atzmo – lo kol shekken!
Rabbi omer: kol davar sheen lo pidyon, yesh kulei. hayeynu tanna kamma! amar rava: ikka benayyhu etzim.
Detanu rabbanan: haomer "hare alay etzim" – lo yifchot mishshene gezirin. rabbi omer: etzim – korban hen, uteunin melach, uteunin tenufa.
Amar rava: ledivre rabbi, etzim teunin etzim. veamar rav pappa: ledivre rabbi, etzim tzerichin kemitza.
Rav pappa amar: kodshe mizbeach temimin venaasu baale mumin veavar ushechatan ikka benayyhu.
Vehatanya: kodshe mizbeach temimin, venaasu baale mumin, veavar ushechatan, rabbi omer: yikkavru,
Vachachamim omrim: yippadu.
Mishna natal even o kora shel hekdesh – hare ze lo maal.

a: Netanah lachavero – hu maal, vachavero lo maal. benaah betoch beto – hare ze lo maal, ad sheyyadur tachteha beshave peruta.

Natal peruta shel hekdesh – hare ze lo maal. netanah lachavero – hu maal, vachavero lo maal. netanah levallan, af al pi shello rachatz maal, shehu omer lo: hare hammerchatz patuach lefanecha, hikkanes urechotz.
Achilato vaachilat chavero, hanayayto vahanayayt chavero, achilato vahanayayt chavero, hanayayto vaachilat chavero – mitztarfin ze im ze, vaafillu lizman merubbe.
Gemara may shena hu, umay shena chavero?! amar shemuel: begizbar, hammesurot lo, askinan.
Benaah betoch beto – eno chayyayv kulei. lema li ad sheyyadur tachteha? kevan deshanneya – maal! amar rav: kegon shehinnichah al pi arubba.
Vechevan devane la, mihat maal. lema mesayyay leh lerav, deamar rav: hammishtachave levayit – asaro.
Amar rav acha bereh derav ika: hanaa hanniret laenayim asra tora.
Lema mesayyay leh: haddar bevayit shel hekdesh, kevan shennehena mimmenna – maal. amar resh lakish: hatam beshehikdisho ulevassof benao.
Aval benao ulevassof hikdisho, may – lo maal? may irya rahet vetane haddar bevayit shel meara – lo maal. lema haddar bevayit shel avanim shebbenao ulevassof hikdisho – lo maal!
Amri: ha pesika leh., ha la pesika leh.
Hadaran alach hannehene
Hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto – baal habbayit maal. lo asa shelichuto – hashshaliach maal.

Ketzad? amar lo: "ten basar laorchim", venatan lahem kaved; "kaved", venatan lahem basar – hashshaliach maal. amar lo: "ten lahem chaticha chaticha", vehu omer: telu shetayim! vehem natlu shalosh – kullam maalu.
b: Gemara man tanna dechol milleta demimmelach ala shaliach tarte mille havyayn?
Amar rav chisda: dela kerabbi akiva, ditnan: hannoder min hayyarak – muttar bedilluin, verabbi akiva oser.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi akiva, mi la bae leimmeloche? ki amaru rabbanan kammeh derava, amar lehu: shappir kaamar nachmani!

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi akiva? rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, detanya: hannoder min habbasar – asur bechol mine basar, veasur barosh uvaraglayim, bakkane uvakkaved uvallev. veasur bivsar ofot, umuttar bivsar dagim vachagavim. rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir barosh uvaraglayim, bakkane uvakkaved, uvaofot uvaddagim uvachagavim.
Vechen haya rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: keravayim lav basar hen, veochlehen lav bar inish.

Uletanna kamma, may shena bivsar ofot? mishshum dirgil inish deamar: la ashkachi bisra dechevta, vaatay bisra detzippera. i hachi, hachi name avid inish lememra: la ashkachi bisra dechevta, vaatay dagim!
Amar rav pappa: beyom hakkaza askinan, dela achel inish dagim.
I hachi, tzippera name la nechol, deamar shemuel: dimsochar veachel tzippera – parach libbeh ketzippera! veod, tanya: en makkizin dam lo al haddagim, velo al haofot, velo al basar maliach.
Ella amar rav pappa: beyoma dechayyvin leh eneh askinan, dela achel dagim.
Amar lo: ten lo chaticha kulei. shema minna: mosif al shelichuto – have shaliach!
Amar rav sheshet: deamar shaliach: tol achat middato veachat middati.

a: Mahu detema: akar shaliach shelichuteh devaal habbayit, vela limol – ka mashma lan.

Mishna amar lo: "have li min hachallon o min haddeloskama", vehevi lo. af al pi sheamar baal habbayit: "lo haya belibbi ella mizze", vehevi mizze – baal habbayit maal. aval im amar lo: "have li min hachallon", vehevi lo min haddeloskama, o "min haddeloskama", vehevi lo min hachallon – hashshaliach maal.
Shillach beyad cheresh shote vekatan, im asu shelichuto – baal habbayit maal, lo asu shelichuto – chenvoni meal.
Shillach beyad pikkeach, venizkar ad shello higgia etzel chenvoni – chenvoni maal lichsheyyotzi.
Ketzad yaase? notel peruta o cheli, veomer: "peruta shel hekdesh bechol makom shehu mechullal al ze", shehahekdesh nifde bechesef uveshave kesef.
Gemara may ka mashma lan? devarim shebballev enam devarim.
Shillach beyad cheresh shote vekatan, im asu [vechulei]. veha lav bene shelichuta ninhu!
Amar rabbi elazar: asaum kemaatan shel zetim,
Ditnan: hazzetim, meematay mekabbelin tumea? mishsheyyazziu zeat hammaatan, velo zeat hakkuppa.

Rabbi yochanan amar: keotah sheshshaninu, netano al gabbe hakkof veholicho, o al gabbe happil veholicho, veamar leacher lekabbelo mimmennu – hare ze eruv. alma ka avda shelichuteh. hachi name, itavid shelichuteh.
Shillach beyad pikkeach vechulei. veaf al gav dela iddechar shaliach. ureminhi: nizkar baal habbayit velo nizkar shaliach – hashshaliach maal, nizkeru shenehem – chenvani maal!
Amar rav sheshet: matnitin name, keshennizkeru shenehem.

Mishna natan lo peruta, amar lo: "have li bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot" vehalach vehevi lo bechullah petilot o bechullah nerot, o sheamar lo: "have li bechullah nerot", o "bechullah petilot", vehalach vehevi bechetzyah nerot uvechetzyah petilot – shenehem lo maalu.
Aval im amar lo: "have li bechetzyah nerot mimmakom peloni uvechetzyah petilot mimmakom peloni", vehalach vehevi lo nerot mimmekom petilot, ufetilot mimmekom nerot – hashshaliach maal.

Natan lo shete ferutot, veamar lo: "lech vehave li etrog", vehalach vehevi lo beachat etrog uveachat rimmon – shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer: baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo: etrog gadol hayiti mevakkesh, veheveta li katan vera.
Natan lo dinar zahav, veamar lo: lech vehave li chaluk,
b: Vehalach vehevi lo bishlosha chaluk uvishlosha tallit – shenehem maalu. rabbi yehuda omer: baal habbayit lo maal, shehu omer lo: chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh, veheveta li katan vera.
Gemara shamat minna, man deamar lishlucho: "zil zeven li kora deara", vaazal uzevan leh litka – kane lokeach!
Amri: hacha hechi dame – kegon deayyti leh shave shesh beshalosh.
Ema sefa: rabbi yehuda omer: baal habbayit lo maal, shehu yachol lomar lo: "chaluk gadol hayiti mevakkesh, veheveta li chaluk katan vera"!
Deamar leh: i yahavat dinar kulleh, ayytet li shave shene dinarin.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: mode rabbi yehuda bekitnit sheshshenehem maalu, shehakkitnit bifruta vekitnit bedinar.
Hechi dame? i beatra dezavni beshuma – gabbe kitnit name, deyahev sela mozli leh tefe! amar rav pappa: beducheta dimzabbeni bechanne kanne, kanna kanna bifruta, dehatam pesik milletayyhu.

Mishna hammafkid maot etzel shulechani, im tzerurin – lo yishtammesh bahen. lefichach, im hotzi – maal. im muttarin – yishtammesh bahen. lefichach, im hotzi – lo maal. etzel baal habbayit – ben kach uven kach lo yishtammesh bahen. lefichach, im hotzi – maal. hachenvoni – kevaal habbayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: keshulechani.
Nafla peruta shel hekdesh betoch kiso, o sheamar "peruta bechis ze hekdesh", kevan shehotzi et harishona – maal, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis.
Umode rabbi akiva lachachamim beomer "peruta min kis ze hekdesh", shehu motzi veholech ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkis.
Gemara ki ata rav dimi, amar: rame leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: may shena resha umay shena sefa?
Amar leh: sefa beomer "lo yippatevr kis ze min hahekdesh".
Ki ata ravin amar: kisin ashshevorim rema leh, ditnan: haomer "echad mishshevorayy hekdesh" – hayu lo shenayim, haggadol shebbahen hekdesh! amar leh: sefa beomer "lo yippatevr kis ze min hahekdesh".

a: Rav pappa amar: kisin alluggin rema leh, ditnan: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutim
Omer: "shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish – hare hen teruma, asara – maaser rishon, tisha – maaser sheni", umechel veshote miyyad, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrim! amar leh: sefa dematnitin beomer "lo yippater kis ze min hahekdesh".
Haderan alach hashshaliach sheasa shelichuto uselika la massechet meila

Ken setuma shepparach mimmenna gozal laavir, o shepparach ben hammetot, o shemmet achad mehen, yikkach zug lashsheni. parach leven hakkerevot, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo, shehaggozal happoreach, pasul ufosel echad kenegdo:

Ketzad. shete nashim, lazo shete kinnim velazo shete kinnim, parach mizzo lazo, posel echad bahalichato. chazar, posel echad bachazirato. parach vechazar, parach vechazar, lo hifsid kelum, sheafillu hen meoravot, en pachot mishshetayim:

Lazo achat, lazo shetayim, lazo shalosh, lazo arba, lazo chamesh, lazo shesh, lazo sheva. parach min harishona lashsheniyya, lashshelishit, larviit, lachamishit, lashshishshit, lashsheviit, chazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. harishona vehashsheniyya en lahem kelum, hashshelishit yesh lah achat, harviit yesh lah shetayim, hachamishit yesh lah shalosh, hashshishshit yesh lah arba, hashsheviit yesh lah shesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato. hashshelishit veharviit en lahem kelum, hachamishit yesh lah achat, hashshishshit yesh lah shetayim, hashsheviit yesh lah chamesh. parach vechazar, posel echad bahalichato veechad bachazirato, hachamishit vehashshishshit en lahem kelum, hashsheviit yesh lah arba. veyesh omrim, hashsheviit lo hifsida chelum. veim parach mibben hammetot lechullam, hare chullam yamutu:
Ken setuma veken meforeshet, parach min hassetuma lamforeshet, yikkach zug lashsheni. chazar, o shepparach min hameforeshet rishon, hare chullan yamutu:

Chattat mikkan veola mikkan usetuma vaemtza, parach min haemtza latztzedadin, echad helach veechad helach, lo hifsid kelum, ella yomar, ze shehalach etzel chattaot, chattat. veze shehalach etzel olot, ola. chazar laemtza, haemtzaiyyim yamutu, ellu yikrevu chattaot, veellu yikrevu olot. chazar o shepparach min haemtza latztzedadin, hare chullan yamutu. en meviin torin keneged bene yona, velo vene yona keneged torin. ketzad. haishsha shehevia chattatah tor, veolatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah tor. olatah tor, vechattatah ben yona, tichpol vetavi olatah ben yona. ben azzay omer, holchin achar harishon. haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta, yaviu hayyorshin olatah. olatah umeta, lo yaviu hayyorshin chattatah:

Bamme devarim amurim, bechohen nimlach. aval bechohen sheeno nimlach, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyam lemala vechetzyam lematta, et shellemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul, veet shellematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul:

Bamme devarim amurim, bechohen nimlach. aval bechohen sheeno nimlach, achat lazo veachat lazo, shetayim lazo ushetayim lazo, shalosh lazo veshalosh lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyam lemala vechetzyam lematta, et shellemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul, veet shellematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul:

Achat lazo, ushetayim lazo, veshalosh lazo, veeser lazo, umea lazo, asa chullan lemala, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, hamerubbe chasher. ze hakkelal, kol makom sheatta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin velo yehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kol makom sheen atta yachol lachalok et hakkinnin ad sheyyehu mishshel ishsha achat, ben milmalan ben millemattan, hamerubbe chasher:

Chattat lazo, veola lazo, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lemattan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, shetehen pasul, sheani omer, chattat kereva lemalan veola lemattan:

Chattat veola usetuma umeforeshet, asa chullan lemalan, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. kullan lematta, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. chetzyan lemalan vechetzyan lemattan, en kasher ella setuma, vehi mitchalleket benehen:

Chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan chattat shebbachova. chova shenayim bechattat, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. vechattat shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova. chova shenayim beola, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. ola shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher:

Chattat shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan chattat shebbachova. chova shenayim bechattat, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. vechattat shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher. vechen ola shennitarva vechova, en kasher ella minyan olot shebbachova. chova shenayim beola, mechetza chasher umechetza fasul. ola shenayim bechova, hamminyan shebbachova kasher:

Haishsha sheamra, hare alay ken kesheeled zachar, yalda zachar, mevia shete kinnim, achat lenidrah veachat lechovatah. netanatam lakkohen, vehakkohen tzarich laasot shalosh peridim milmalan veachat millemattan. lo asa chen, ella asa shetayim lemalan ushetayim lemattan velo nimlach, tzericha lehavi od perida achat, veyakrivenna lemalan, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shetayim. persha nidrah, tzericha lehavi od shalosh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi arba. kava nidrah, tzericha lehavi od chamesh peridim, mimmin echad. mishshene minin, tavi shesh. netanatam lakkohen veen yadua ma natna, halach hakkohen veasa veen yadua me asa, tzericha lehavi od arba peridim lenidrah, ushetayim lechovatah, vechattat echat. ben azzay omer, shete chattaot. amar rabbi yehoshua, ze hu sheamru, keshehu chay kolo echad, ucheshehu met kolo shiva. ketzad kolo shiva. shete karnav, shete chatzotzrot. shete shokav, shene chalilin. oro, letof. meav, linvalim. bene meav, lechinnorot. veyesh omrim, af tzamro litchelet. rabbi shimon ben akashya omer, zikne am haaretz, kol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mittarefet alehen, shenneemar (Iyov 12), mesir safa leneemanim vetaam zekenim yikkach. aval zikne tora enan chen, ella chol zeman shemmazkinin, datan mityashshevet alehen, shenneemar (sham), bishishim chachma veorech yamim tevuna:
b: Mishna bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash: bet avtinas, bet hannitzotz, bet hammoked. bevet avtinas uvevet hannitzotz hayu aliyyot, harovim shomrim sham. Bet hammoked kippa, uvayit haggadol haya, mukkaf rovdin shel even. zikne bet av yeshenim sham umaftechot haazara beyadam. Pirche chehunna ish kisto baaretz. lo hayu yeshenim bevigde kodesh, ella hayu poshtin umannichin otan tachat rashehem, umitkassin bichsut atzman. era keri leechad mehen – yotze veholech lo

a: Bimsibba haholechet lo tachat habbira. venerot dolkin mikkan umikkan. ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. umedura hayta sham. uvet hakkisse shel kavod. ze haya kevodo: metzao naul – yodea sheyyesh sham adam. patuach – beyadua sheen sham adam.
Yarad, vetaval, ala venistappeg, venitchammem keneged hammedura. ba, veyashav lo etzel echav hakkohanim, ad shehayu shearim niftachim, yotze veholech lo.

Mi shehu rotze litrom et hammizbeach, mashkim vetovel ad shello yavo hamemunne. vechi beeze shaa ba hamemunne? lo kol haittim shavot, peamim shehu ba mikkerot haggever, o samuch lo millefanav o meacharav.
Hamemunne ba, vedafak alehen, vehen patchu lo, amar lahen: mi shettaval – yavo veyafis, hefisu, mi shezzacha – zacha bo.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar abbaye: amar kera "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav shomrim mishmeret hammikdash lemishmeret bene yisrael".

Amri: in, shimmur bealma ashkechan devae, kohanim uleviyyim shimmur. mihu matnitin katane: bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash, vehaleviyyim beesrim veechad makom, veillu kera, kohanim uleviyyim bahade hadade ketiv!
Amri, hachi kaamar: "vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe vahadar aharon uvanav shomre mishmeret hammikdash". aharon – bechad makom, uvanav – bishne mekomot.
Mimmay? middichtiv "vehachonim", uchetiv "shomrim". "chonim" lechod, veshomrim" lechod.
Ema kullehu bechad makom lechodeh! la salka datach: ma moshe – bechad makom lechodeh, af aharon uvanav – bechad makom lechodeh.
Rav ashe amar, missefeh dikra: "shomrim mishmeret ... lemishmeret".
b: Bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz. ibbaya lehu: aliyyot mammash havo, o dilma dahavo gevihi migbah kaaliyyot?
Ta shema, ditnan: shebbatztzafon shaar hannitzotz kemin achsadra haya, vaaliyyay benuya al gabbah, shehakkohanim shomrim milmala, vehaleviyyim millematta. ufetach haya lo lachol.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "veyillavu alecha vishartucha" – baavodatcha hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer baavodatcha hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella baavodatam! keshehu omer "venilvu alecha veshamru lechol kelav ulechol avodato" – hare baavodatam amur. ha ma ani mekayyem "veyillavu alecha vishartucha" – baavodatcha hakkatuv medabber. ha ketzad? kohanim shomrim milmala, uleviyyim millematta.
Bet hammoked kippa, uvayit gadol haya.

Vechad shomer hu dahava bevet hammoked? ureminhi: shene shearim hayu bevet hammoked, echad patuach lachel, veechad patuach laazara. amar rabbi yehuda: baze shennichnasin laazara – pishpash katan haya lo, shebbo nichnasin livlosh haazara! amar abbaye: kevan degabbe hadade havo kayymi – saggi lehu bechad shomer, dave lehacha vedave lehacha.
Mukkaf rovdin shel even. rovdin may nihu? gizrata deitztevata desalki behu leitztevata. umi havo mippalgi avanim? vehachtiv: "vehabbayit behibbanoto even shelema vegomer"!
Amar abbaye: dimtakkeni umayyti meikkara avne zuterata veavne ravrevata, kedichtiv: "avne eser ammot veavne shemone ammot".
Zikne bet av yeshenim sham. veammay? leayyeyli mittot! amar abbaye: lav orach ara leayyole mittot levet hammikdash.
Pirche chehunna, ish kesuto baaretz. ammay hatam kare lehu "rovim", hacha kare lehu

a: "Pirche chehunna"? amri: in, hatam, dela matu lemebad avoda – kare lehu "rovim", hacha, dematu lehu lemebad avoda – kare lehu "pirche".
Tenan hatam: bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash: bevet avtinas, uvevet hannitzotz, uvevet hammoked.

Vehaleviyyim beesrim veechad mekomot: chamishsha – al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. arbaa – al arba pinnotav mibbifnim. chamishsha – al chamishsha shaare azara. vearbaa – al arba pinnotav mibbachutz. echad – belishkat hakkorban, veechad – belishkat happarochet, veechad – achore bet hakkapporet.

Menahane mille? amar rav yehuda missura, veamri la bematnita tana, dichtiv: "lammizrach haleviyyim shishsha latztzafona layyom arbaa lannegba layyom arbaa velaasuppim shenayim shenayim lapparbar lammaarav arbaa lamsilla shenayim lapparbar".
Amri: hane esrim vearbea havu! amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: laasuppim – shenayim (shenayim).
Akkatti, esrin utere havu! hayech defarbar – chad hava, veacharina, betzavvta hu deazel veyatev gabbeh – mishshum dekae abbaray.
May "lapparbar"? amar rabba bar rav shela: keman deamar "kelappe bar".
Veibbaet ema: leolam esrim vearbea, kedichtiv. telata minnayyhu – dechohanim, veesrin vechad – dilviyyim.
Veha hacha, leviyyim hu dichtiv! kerabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beesrim vearbaa mekomot nikreu kohanim leviyyim, veze echad mehen – "vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok".

Chamishsha – al chamishsha shaare har habbayit, vearbaa – al arbaa pinnotav mittocho. chamishsha – al chamishsha shaare azara, vearbaa – al arbaa pinnotav mibbachutz. may shena har habbayit deavdinan mittocho, umay shena azara deavdinan mibbachutz?
Amri: har habbayit, dei tama uvae metav – yatev, amrinan mittocho. azara, dei tama uvae lemetav – la matze yatev, deamar mar: en yeshiva baazara ella lemalche vet david bilvad, amrinan mibbachutz.
Amar mar: chamishsha al chamishsha shaare azara. vachamishsha shearim hu dehave baazara?! ureminhi shiva shearim hayu baazara, shelosha batztzafon, ushelosha baddarom, veechad bammizrach!

Amar abbaye: tere minnayyhu la tzerichi shimmur. rava amar: tannae hi. detanya: en pochatin mishshelosha asar gizbarin umishshiva amarkalin. rabbi natan omer: en pochatin mishshelosha asar gizbarin, keneged shelosha asar shearim. dal chamsha dehar habbayit – pashu lehu temanya daazara. alma, ikka tanna deamar temanya havu, veikka tanna deamar shiva, veikka tanna deamar chamsha havu.
Lo hayu yeshenim bevigde kodesh kulei. shena hu dela, aval hilluch – mehallechim. shamat minna: bigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahen!
Amri: hu haddin daafillu hilluch name la, veha dekatane lo hayu yeshenim – mishshum devae lemitne sefa: ella poshtin umekappelin umannichin otan tachat rashehen, katane resha name: lo hayu yeshenim.
Veha gufa ka kashya: umannichin otan tachat rashehen – shema minna bigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahem! ema: neged rashehem.
Amar rav pappa, shema minna: tefillin min hatztzad – sharyayn, vela chayyshinan dilma miggandar venafel alayyhu.
Hachi name mistabbera dichneged rashehen, dei amrat tachat rashehen, nehi denittenu lehanot bahen, tippok leh mishshum issura dechilayim!
b: Hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot. ella leman deamar avneto shel kohen hedyot zehu avneto shel kohen gadol, may ikka lememar?

Vechi tema: kilayim baaliyya ulevisha hu deasur, aval memach tuteh shappir dame, vehatanya: "lo yaale alecha" – aval atta matztzio tachtecha. aval amru chachamim: asur laasot ken, shemma tikkarech nima achat al besaro.

Vechi tema demafsek midde, vehaamar rabbi shimon, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amar rabbi yose ben shaul mishshum kehala kaddisha shebbirushalayim: afillu eser matztzaot zo al gav zo, vechilayim tachtehen – asur lishan alehen. ella shema minna, neged rashehen.
Vei baet ema: beotan sheen bahen kilayim. rav ashe amar: bigde chehunna kashin hen, deamar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: ha namta gamda denaresh – sharya.
Ta shema: bigde chehunna, hayyotze bahen limdina – asur. uvammikdash, ben bishat avoda uven shello bishat avoda – muttar. mippene shebbigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahen. shema minna.
Uvammedina la? vehatanya: beesrim veechad bo – yom har gerizim, dela lemispad, kidita beyoma perek "ba lo kohen gadol karov vechulei"?!
Ad ibbaet ema: reuyin hen levigde chehunna.
Vei baet ema: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha".
Era keri beechad mehen [vechulei].
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar: mechillot lo nitkaddeshu. baal keri mishtalleach chutz lishne machanot.
Vehannerot dolkin mikkan umikkan kulei. rav safra hava yatev bevet hakkisse, ata rabbi abba nechar leh. amar leh: leul mar!
Batar denafek, amar leh rabbi abba: ad kan la selekt leseir, gemart mille deseir?! lav hachi tenan: metzao naul – beyadua sheyyesh sham adam! lememra dela mibbee leh lemeal!
Verav safra savar: dilma mesukkan hu. kidtanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ammud hachozer – mevi et haadam lide hidrokan, silon hachozer – mevi et haadam lide yerakon.
Amar leh rav lechiyyay bereh, vechen amar leh rav huna lerabba bereh: chashshech takken nafshach, ukedem takken nafshach – ki hechi dela tirchak. tuv vegalli. kassi vekum.
Shetof usheti. [shetof] veachet. uchesheatta shote mayim – shefoch mehen, veachar kach ten letalmidecha.

Kidtanya: lo yishte adam mayim veyitten letalmido, ella im ken shafach mehen. umaase beechad sheshshata mayim velo shafach mehen, venatan letalmido, veoto talmid istenis haya, velo ratza lishtot, umet batztzama. beotah shaa amru: lo yishte adam mayim veyitten letalmido ella im ken shafach mehen. rav ashe amar: hilkach, hay talmida deshafech kamme rabbeh – let beh mishshum afkiruta.
Kol mille la tiflot beappe rabbach, bar mikkara vedayysa, dechiftila shel avar damu.
Tenan hatam: ish har habbayit haya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar, vaavukot dolkot lefanav. vechol mishmar sheeno omed veomer lo: "ish har habbayit

a: Shalom alecha"! – nikkar shehu yashen, chovto bemaklo. ureshut hayta lo lisrof et kesuto. vehem omrim: ma kol baazara? kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin, sheyyashan lo al mishmar. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: paam achat matzu et achi immi yashen, vesarfu et kesuto.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ki mate rabbi yochanan beha matnita, amar hachi: ashrehem larishonim, sheafillu al ones shena osin din. shello al ones shena – al achat kamma vechamma.

Tanya, rabbi omer: ezo hi derech yeshara sheyyavor lo haadam? yeehav et hattochachot, shekkol zeman shettochachot baolam – nachat ruach baa laolam, tova uveracha bain laolam, veraa mistalleket min haolam, shenneemar: "velammochichim yinam vaalehem tavo birkat tov". veyesh omrim: yachzik beemuna yetera, shenneemar: "enay beneemne eretz lashevet immadi vegomer".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: kol hammochiach et chavero leshem shamayim – zoche lechelko shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "mochiach adam acharay". velo od, ella shemmoshchin alav chut shel chesed, shenneemar: "chen yimtza mimmachalik lashon".

Metzao naul yodea vechulei. mi shehu rotze litrom et hammizbeach [vechulei]. ha gufa kashya, amrat: mi shehu rotze litrom et hammizbeach – mashkim vetovel ad shello yavo hamemunne. alma lav befayis talya milleta. vahadar tane: yavo vifayyes, alma befayis talya milleta!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, kan – kodem takkana. kan – leachar takkana.

Ditnan: barishona kol mi sherotze litrom et hammizbeach, torem. bizman shehen merubbin – ratzin veolin bakkevesh, kol hakkodem et chavero betoch arba ammot – zacha. hayu shenayim shavin, hamemunne omer lahem: "hatzebiu".
Uma hen motziin? achat o shetayim. veen motziin guddal bammikdash.

Maase shenayim hayu shavin, ratzin veolin bakkevesh, vedachaf echad mehem et chavero, venishbera raglo. uchesherau bet din shehayu baim lide sakkana, hitkinu shello yehu tormin et hammizbeach ella befayis.
Rava amar: idde veidde leachar takkana, vehachi katane: mi shehu rotze lavo ulefayyes – mashkim vetovel ad shello yavo hamemunne.
Mishna natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara, venichnesu hakkohanim acharav, ushete avukot shel or beyadam.

Nechleku lishte chittot, ellu mehallechin baachsadra derech mizrach, veellu mehallechin baachsadra derech maarav. hayu bodkin veholchim ad shemmaggiim limkom ose chavittim. higgiu – ellu vaellu amru: "shalom, hakkol shalom". heemidu ose chavittim laasot chavittim.

Mi shezzacha litrom et hammizbeach, hu yitrom. vehem omrim: heve zahir shello tigga bakkeli ad shettekaddesh yadecha veraglecha min hakkiyyor. vahare hammachta netuna bammiktzoa ben hakkevesh lammizbeach, bemaaravo shel kevesh.
En adam nichnas immo. velo ner beyado, ella mehallech leor hammaaracha. lo hayu roin oto,
b: Velo hayu shomin et kolo, ad shehayu shomin kol haetz sheasa ben katin mucheni lakkiyyor. vehen omrim: higgia et! kiddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, natal machtat hakkesef veala lerosh hammizbeach.

Pinna et haggechalim helach, chote et hameukkalot happenimiyyot. yarad higgia laritzpa, hafach panav latztzafon, holech bemizracho shel kevesh keeser ammot. tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe haritzpa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim, makom shennotnim mureat haof, vedishshun mizbeach happenimi, vedishshun hammenora.
Gemara umi havo achsadraot baazara? veha tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: minnayin sheen osin achsadraot baazara – talmud lomar: "lo titta lecha ashera kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha",
Hachi kaamar: "lo titta lecha ashera", "lo titta lecha kol etz etzel mizbach Adonai elohecha"! amar rav chisda: beachsadraot shel binyan.
Hayu bodkin veholchin kulei. lememra dachavittin havo kedimi?
Vehattanya: minnayin sheen davar kodem letamid shel shachar – talmud lomar: "vearach aleha haola", veamar rabba: "haola", ola rishona! amar rav yehuda: lehachem chammin lirvicha.
Hadaran alach bishlosha mekomot
Mishna rauhu echav sheyyarad, vehem ratzim uvaim. miharu vekiddeshu yedehem veraglehem min hakkiyyor, natlu et hammagrefot veet hatztzinnorot vealu lerosh hammizbeach.
Haevarim vehappedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev – solkin otan al tzidde hammizbeach, im en tzedadim machzikin – sodrim otam bassovev al hakkevesh.
Hechellu maalin baefer al gav tappuach. tappuach haya beemtza hammizbeach, peamim shehayu alav kishlosh meot kor. uvargalim lo hayu medashshenin oto, mippene shehu noy lammizbeach. umiyyamav

a: Lo nitatztzel hakkohen millehotzi et haddeshen.

Hechellu maalin baggezirin lesadder et hammaaracha. vechi kol haetzim kesherin lammaaracha hen? kol haetzim kesherin lammaaracha chutz mishshel gefen veshel zayit. aval beellu hayu regilin: bemurbiyyot shel teena, shel egoz, veshel etz shemen.
Sidder et hammaaracha gedola mizracha, vachazitah mizracha. verashe gezirin happenimim hayu nogin battappuach. verevach haya ben haggezirim, shehayu matztzitim et haalita mishsham.
Berru mishsham atze teena yafim, sidder et hammaaracha sheniyya liktoret keneged maaravit deromit, mashuch min hakkeren kelappe tzafon arba ammot.

Beomed chamesh sein gechalim. uveshabbat – beomed shemone sein gechalim. sheshsham hayu notnim shene beziche levona shel lechem happanim. haevarim vehappedarim shello (hayu) nitakkelu mibbaerev, machazirin otan lammaaracha, vehitztzitu shete maarachot baesh. yardu uvau lahem lelishkat haggazit.
Gemara amar rava: guzema. hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav, amar rava: guzema.
Amar rabbi amme: dibbera tora leshon havay, dibberu neviim leshon havay, dibberu chachamim leshon havay.
Dibbera tora leshon havay – dichtiv: "arim gedolot uvetzurot bashshamayim", bashshamayim salka datach?! ella guzema.
Dibberu chachamim leshon havay – ha daamaran: tappuach, vehishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav.
Dibberu neviim leshon havay – dichtiv: "(vechol am haaretz) mechallelim bachalilim vegomer vattibbaka haaretz lekolam".
Amar rabbi yannay bar nachmani, amar shemuel: bishlosha mekomot dibberu chachamim bilshon havay, veellu hen: tappuach, gefen, ufarochet.
Leappoke midderava, ditnan: hishku et hattamid bechos shel zahav, veamar rava: guzema, ka mashma lan: hane – in, hatam – la. en aniyyut bimkom ashirut.
Tappuach – ha daamaran. gefen – detanya: gefen zahav hayta omedet al petach hahechol, umudela al gabbe kelonsot, vechol mi shemmitnaddev ale
b: O gargir, o eshkol – mevi vetole bah. amar rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: maase haya, venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim lefannotah.
Parochet – ditnan rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshum rabbi shimon hassegan: parochet ovyah tefach, al shivim ushenayim nimin neereget, veal kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin.
Orkah arbaim amma, verochbah esrim amma. umishshemonim ushetayim ribbo naaset, ushetayim osin bechol shana veshana, ushelosh meot kohanim matbilin otah.

Hechellu maalin baggezirin lesadder et hammaaracha [vechulei]. chutz mishshel zayit umishshel gefen [vechulei]. hane may tama? rav pappa amar: mishshum diktiri. rav acha bar yaakov amar: mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael.
Metivi: "al haetzim asher al haesh" – etzim hannittochim lihyot esh, umay nihu? dukere shappud dela ketiri veazli mikketar mittocho!

Vechi kol haetzim kesherim lammaaracha hen? kol haetzim kesherim, chutz min zayit vegefen. aval beellu hayu regilin: bemurbiyyot shel teena, veshel egoz, veshel etz shemen. rabbi eliezer mosif af shel mayish, veshel allon, veshel dekel, veshel charuv, veshel shikma.

Bishlama leman deamar mishshum diktiri, beha kamippalgi: demar savar: af al gav dela ketiri miggavvay, kevan diktiri mibbaray – la mayytinan. umar savar: kevan dela ketiri miggavvay, af al gav demibbaray ketiri – mayytinan.
Ella leman deamar mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael: dekel mi let beh mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael?
Amar lach: velitamaych: teena let bah mishshum yishshuv deeretz yisrael?! ella may it lach lememar? bitena dela avida pera, dekel name – bidla aved pera.
Umi ikka teena dela avda pera? in, kidrachava. deamar rachava: mayyti teene chivvarata,

a: Veshayyfi lehu bechavla detzavta disrich aleh bizra, vekavri hecha demassek yamma sirton, kora – avda, pere – la avda, utelat beriche minnayyhu la machzeka lehu gamla.
Sidder et hammaaracha gedola vechulei. may tama? rav huna verav chisda. chad amar: kede shettehe haruach menashshevet bah, vechad amar: kede sheyyehu matztzitin haalita mishsham.
Metivi: revach haya bahen ben haggezirin, shehayu matztzitin haalita mishsham. amar lach, mekomot mekomot avdi.
Hadaran alach rauhu echav
Amar lahen hamemunne bou vehafisu: mi hashshochet, umi hazzorek, mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, mi medashshen et hammenora, mi maale evarim lakkevesh.
Harosh veharegel shel yamin, ushete hayyadayim, haoketz veharegel shel semol, hechaze vehaggera, ushete defanot, hakkeravayim, vehassolet, vehachavittin vehayyayin.
Hefisu, zacha mi shezzacha.
Amar lahen: tzeu ureu im higgia zeman shechita. im higgia, haroe omer: "barkay". matya ben shemuel omer: heir pene kol hammizrach ad shehu bechevron? vehu omer: "hen".

Amar lahen: tzeu vehaviu (li, vehotziu) tale millishkat hattelaim. vahare lishkat hattelaim netuna bemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit. arba leshachot hayu sham: achat – lishkat hattelaim, veachat – lishkat hachotamot, veachat – lishkat bet hammoked, veachat – lishka sheosin bah lechem happanim.
Nichnesu lelishkat hakkelim, hotziu mishsham tishim ushelosha kele chesef uchele zahav, hishku et hattamid bakkos
b: Shel zahav. af al pi shehu mevukkar mibbaerev – mevakkerin oto leor avukot.

Mi shezzacha bedishshun mizbeach happenimi uvedishshun hammenora, hayu makdimin, vearbaa kelim beyadam: hatteni vehakkuz ushene maftechot. hatteni – dome letarkav shel zahav machazik kabbayim vachetzi. vehakkuz – dome lekiton gadol shel zahav. ushete maftechot – echad shehu yored beammat hashshechi, veechad shehu poteach kevan.

Ba lo lappishpash hatztzefoni. shene pishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, achat batztzafon, veachat baddarom. shebbaddarom lo nichnas bo adam. alav hu meforash al yede yechezkel, shenneemar: "vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish al yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur".

Natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas lehatta, umehatta lahechol, ad shemmaggia leshaar haggadol. higgia leshaar haggadol, heevir et hanneger veet happotchot ufetacho. lo haya shochet hashshochet ad sheshshomea shaar gadol shenniftach.

Miricho hayu shomin kol shaar gadol shenniftach. miricho hayu shomin kol magrefa. miricho hayu shomin kol hashshir. miricho hayu shomin kol ben arza makkish batztziltzel. miricho hayu shomin kol hechalil.

Miricho hayu shomin kol gevini karoz. miricho hayu shomin kol haetz sheasa ben katin mucheni lakkiyyor. miricho hayu shomin kol hashshir. miricho hayu shomin kol hashshofar. veyesh omrim af kolo shel kohen gadol beshaa shehu mazkir et hashshem beyom hakkippurim.
Miricho hayu merechin reach pittum hakketoret. amar rabbi elazar ben diglay: izzim hayu leabba (beare) [behare] hammichvor, vehayu mitatteshot mereach pittum hakketoret.

Mi shezzacha battamid – meshacho veholech bevet hammitbachayim. umi shezzachu baevarim holchin immo. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasim, urevaim shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelaot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahen, ushelosha sedarim lechol echad veechad, shebbahen tolin umafshitin al shulechanot shel shayish shebben haammudim.
Mi shezzacha bedishshun mizbeach happenimi – nichnas venatal et hatteni, vehinnicho lefanav, vehaya chofen venoten letocho. uvaacharona, kibbed et hashshear letocho, vehinnicho veyatza.

Mi shezzacha bedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachit maaravit dolkin – medashshen et hashshear, umanniach et ellu dolkin bimkoman. metzaan shekkavu – medashshenan umadlikan min haddolkin, veachar kach medashshen et hashshear.
Veeven hayta lifne hammenora, uvah shalosh maalot shealeha kohen omed umetiv et hannerot, (umanniach) [hinniach] et hakkuz al maala sheniyya, veyatza.
Hadaran alach amar lahem hamemunne
Mishna lo hayu koftin et hattale, ella maakidin oto. mi shezzachu baevarim, ochazin bo. vechach haya akedato: rosho laddarom, ufanav lammaarav. vehashshochet omed bammizrach, ufanav lammaarav.
Shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, al tabbaat sheniyya. shel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit, al tabbaat sheniyyay.
Shachat hashshochet, vekibbel hamekabbel, ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit, venoten mizracha tzafona. maaravit deromit, venoten maarava daroma. sheyare haddam haya shofech el yesod deromit.

a: Lo haya shover bo et haregel, ella nokvo mittoch arkubbo, vetole bo.

Haya mafshit veyored ad shemmaggia lechaze. higgia lechaze, chatach et harosh, unetano lemi shezzacha bo. chatach et hakkeraayim, unetanan lemi shezzacha bahen. merak et hahefshet. kara et hallev vehotzi et damo.
Chatach et hayyadayim, unetanan lemi shezzacha bahen. ala laregel hayemanit, chatachah, unetanah lemi shezzacha bah, ushete betzim immah. kerao, venimtza kullo galuy lefanav.

Natal et happeder, unetano al bet shechitat harosh millemala. natal et hakkeravayim, unetanan lemi shezzacha bahen, lahadichan. vehakkares medichin otah bevet hammedichin. umedichin otah kol tzorkah, vehakkeravayim medichin otan shalosh peamim bemiutan, al shulechanot shel shayish shebben haammudim.
Natal et hassakkin, vehifrish et harea min hakkaved, veetzba hakkaved min hakkaved, velo haya mezizah mimmekomah. nokav et hechaze, unetano lemi shezzacha.
Ala laddofen hayyemanit, haya chotech veyored ad hashshidra, velo haya nogea bashshidra, ad shemmaggia leven shete tzelaot dakkot. chatachah, unetanah lemi shezzacha bah, vehakkaved teluya bah.
Ba lo laggera, hinniach bah shete tzelaot mikkan, ushete tzelaot mikkan. chatachah, unetanah lemi shezzacha bah, hakkane vehallev veharea teluyim bah.

Ba lo laddofen hassemalit, hinniach bah shete tzelaot dakkot millemalan, ushete tzelaot dakkot millemattan, vechach haya manniach bachavertah. nimtza manniach shetayim shetayim millemalan, shetayim shetayim millemattan.

Chatachah venatna lemi shezzacha bah, vehashshidra immah, vehattechol taluy bah, vehi hayta gedola, ella shel yamin korin gedola – shehakkaved teluya bah. ba lo laoketz, chatacho, unetano lemi shezzacha bo. haalya, veetzba hakkaved, ushete kelayot immo. natal et haregel hassemalit, chatachah, unetanah lemi shezzacha bah. nimtzeu kullan omdim beshura, vehaevarim beyadam.
b: Harishon – barosh uvaregel. harosh bimino, vechotmo kelappe zeroo, karnav ben etzbeotav, bet shechitato millemalan, vehappeder natun aleha. haregel shel yamin bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashsheni – bishte yadayim, shel yamin bimino, veshel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz.

Hashshelishi – baoketz uvaregel. haoketz bimino, vehaalya meduledelet ben etzbeotav, veetzba hakkaved ushete kelayot immo. haregel shel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. harvii – bechaze uvaggera. hechaze bimino vehaggera bismolo, vetzalotav ben shene etzbeotav. hachamishi – bishte defanot, shel yamin bimino, veshel semol bismolo, uvet oran lachutz. hashshishshi – bakkeravayim hannetunim bevazech, ucheraayim al gabbehen millemala.
Hashshevii – bassolet. hashshemini – bachavittim. hatteshii – bayyayin. halchu unetanum mechatzi kevesh ulematta, bemaaravo. umelachum, veyardu uvau lahen lelishkat haggazit likrot et shema.
Gemara tana: yad varegel, kaakedat yitzchak ben avraham.
Lo hayu koftin et hattale. may tama? rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: mishshum bizyon kodashim. vechad amar: mishshum dimhallech bechukke haammim.
May benayyhu? ikka venayyhu dechafteh beshirae. i name, behutza dedahava.
Tenan hatam: shelosh esre shulechanot hayu bammikdash. shemona shel shayish bevet hammitbachayim, shealehem medichin et hakkeravayim.
Shenayim bammaarav shel kevesh, echad shel shayish veechad shel kesef. al shel shayish notnin et haevarim, veal shel kesef kele sharet.
Uvaulam shenayim mibbifnim al petach habbayit, echad shel kesef veechad shel zahav. al shel kesef notnin lechem happanim bichnisato, veal shel zahav bitziato.
Shemmaalin bakkodesh velo moridin. veechad shel zahav bifnim, shealav lechem happanim tamid.

Mikkede en aniyyut bimkom ashirut, ammay avdi deshayish? naybedu dechesef, naybedu dezahav! amar rav chinnana beshem rabbi assi, verabbi assi beshem rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: mippene shehu martiach.
Shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit. mena hane mille? amar rav chisda: deamar kera "shenayim layyom", keneged hayyom.

Tanya name hachi: "shenayim layyom" – keneged hayyom. atta omer neged hayyom, o eno ella chovat hayyom? keshehu omer "et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim" – hare chovat hayyom amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "shenayim layyom" – neged hayyom.
Ha chetzad? tamid shel shachar – haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, al tabbaat sheniyya, veshel ben haarbayim – haya nishchat al keren tzefonit mizrachit, al tabbaat sheniyya.
Asara devarim shaal alekkesanderos mokdon et zikne hannegev, amar lahen:

a: Min hashshamayim laaretz rachok, o mimmizrach lammaarav? amru lo: mimmizrach lammaarav. teda, shehare chamma bammizrach – hakkol mistakkelin bah, chamma bammaarav – hakkol mistakkelin bah, chamma beemtza rakia – en hakkol mistakkelin bah.

Vachachamim omrim: ze vaze keechad shavin, shenneemar: "kigvoah shamayim al haaretz [vegomer] kirchok mizrach mimmaarav". vei chad minnayyhu nefish, nichtov tarvavyyhu ki hahu dinfish! veella, chamma beemtza rakia may tama en hakkol mistakkelin bah – mishshum dekae lehedya, vela kase leh midde.
Amar lahen: shamayim nivreu techilla o haaretz? amru: shamayim nivreu techilla, shenneemar: "bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz".

Amar lahen: or nivra techilla, o choshech? amru lo: milleta da en la patar. venemru leh choshech nivra techilla, dichtiv: "vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech", vahadar "vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or"!
Savri, dilma ate leshayyole ma lemala uma lematta, ma lefanim uma leachor.
I hachi, shamayim name la nemru leh?! meikkara sevur akray bealma hu deka shayel, kevan dachazo dekahadar shael, savri la nema leh, dilma ate leshayyole ma lemala ma lematta, ma lefanim uma leachor.

Amar lahem: eden mitkere chakkim? amaru leh: ezehu chacham – haroe et hannolad. amar lahem: eden mitkere gibbor? amru lo: ezehu gibbor – hakkovesh et yitzro. amar lahen: eden mitkere ashir? amaru leh: ezehu ashir – hassameach bechelko.

Amar lehon: ma yaaved inish veyichye? amaru leh: yamit atzmo. ma yaaved inish veyamut? yechayye et atzmo. amar lehon: ma yaaved inish veyitkabbel al beriyyayta? amaru: yisne malchu vesholtan. amar lehu: didi tava middidchu, yircham malchu vesholtan, vayyaaved tevu im bene inasha.
Amar lehon: beyamma yae lemedar, o beyabbishta yae lemedar? amaru leh: beyabbishta yae lemedar, deha kol nachote yamma la miyyatteva datehon ad desalkin leyabbishta.
Amar lahen: eden minnechon chakkim yattir? amru lo: kullana kachada shavavyin, deha kol milleta daamart lana – bechad petarna lach. amar lahen: ma den atrestun lekivli! amaru leh: sitna natzach.
Amar lehon: ha ana mekattelna yatchon bigzerat malchin! amaru leh: sholtan beyad malka, vela yae lemalka kazav. miyyad albesh yathon levushin deargevon, ushedi menicha dedahava al tzavverehon.
Amar lehon: baena deezil limdinat afrike. amaru leh: la matzet azlat, defaski hare choshech. amar lehon: la saggi dela azelna, ammetu hachi meshayyelna lechu, ella may eeved?
Amaru leh: ayyti chamare luvae defarshi behavera. veayyti kibbure dematne, uketar behay gisa, dechi atet (beorcha), naktat begavvayyhu veatet leatrach.

Avad hachi, vaazal meta lehahu machoza dechulleh neshe. bae lemibad kerava bahadayyhu, amaru leh: i katlat lan, yemru: neshe ketal. i (katelna) [katlinan] lach, yemru: malka dekatlu neshe. amar lahen: ayyto li nahama. ayyto leh nahama dedahava appatura dedahava.
b: Amar lehu: mi achli inashe nahama dedahava? amaru leh: ella i nahama baet, la hava lach beatrach nahama lemechal, dishkalt vaatet lehacha? ki nafek veate, ketav abbava demachoza: ana alekkesanderos mokdon, haveti shatyay ad daateti limdinat afrike dinshayya, vilefit etza min neshayya.
Ki shakel veate, yatev ahahu mayayna, ka achel nahama. havo bideh gildane demilcha, bahade dimchavvevri lehu – nefal behu recha. amar: shema minna hay ena miggan eden ate.

Ikka deamri: shekal mehanhu mayya, tera beappeh. ikka deamri: iddalli kulleh ad dimta lefitcha degan eden, rema kala: pitchu li bava! amaru leh "ze hashshaar laAdonai vegomer". amar lehon: ana name malka ana, michshav chashivna, havu li midde. yehavu leh gulegulta chada, atyay takleh lechulleh dahava vechaspa dideh bahaday, la hava (matkaleh).

Amar lehon lerabbanan: may hay? amri gulegulta deena devisra udema [hu], dela ka sava. amar lehu: mimmay dehachi hu? shakli kallil afra vechasseyu, lealtar tekala, dichtiv: "sheol vaavaddon lo tisbana vegomer".
Tana deve eliyyahu: gehinnam lemala min harakia, veyesh omrim laachore hare choshech.

Tana rabbi chiyyay: kol haosek battora ballayla – shechina kenegdo, shenneemar: "kumi ronni vallayla lerosh ashmurot shifchi chammayim libbech nochach pene Adonai (vegomer)". amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam, shenneemar: "vechol banayich limmude Adonai verav shelom banayich".
Hadaran alach lo hayu koftin
1 Amar lahem hamemunne: barchu beracha achat! vehem berchu. karu aseret haddibberot, "shema", "vehaya im shamoa", "vayyomer".
Berchu et haam shalosh berachot: "emet veyatztziv", vaavoda uvirkat kohanim. uvashshabbat mosifin beracha achat lammishmar hayyotze.

2 Amar lahem: chadashim liktoret bou vehafisu. zacha mi shezzacha, amar lahem: chadashim im yeshanim, bou vehafisu mi maale evarim min hakkevesh lammizbeach. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: hammaale evarim lakkevesh, hu maale otan al gabbe hammizbeach.
3 Mesarum lachazzanim, hayu mafshitin otam et bigdehem, velo hayu mannichin alehem ella michnasayim bilvad. vechallonot hayu sham, vechatuv alehem tashmish hakkelim.
4 Mi shezzacha bakketoret haya notel et hakkaf, vehakkaf dome letarkav gadol shel zahav machzeket shelosha kabbin, vehabbazech haya betocho.

a: Male vegadush ketoret, vechissuy haya lo. uchemin metotelet haya alav millemalan.

5 Mi shezzacha bammachta, natal machtat hakkesef veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim helach [vehelach], vechata (min hameukkalot happenimiyyot). yarad veeran letoch shel zahav, nitpazzer mimmennu kekav gechalim, vehaya mechabbedan laamma.

Uvashshabbat haya kofe alehen pesachter. ufesachter hayta keli gadol machzeket letech. ushete sharsherot hayu bah, achat – shehu moshech bah veyored. veachat – shehu ochez bah millemalan, bishvil shello titgalgel.
Ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet: kofin otah al gabbe gechalim, veal hashsheretz bashshabbat, umoridin bah et haddeshen meal gabbe hammizbeach.
6 Higgiu ben haulam velammizbeach, natal echad et hammagrefa uzerakah ben haulam velammizbeach. en adam shomea kol chavero birushalayim mikkol hammagrefa.

Ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet: kohen sheshshomea et kolah, yodea sheechav hakkohanim nichnasim lehishtachavot, vehu ratz uva. uven levi shehu shomea et kolah, yodea sheechav haleviyyim nichnasim ledabber bashshir, vehu ratz uva. verosh hammaamad, haya maamid et hattemeim beshaar hammizrach.
Hadaran alach amar lahem hamemunne

1 Hechellu olim bemaalot haulam. mi shezzachu bedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora hayu makdimim lifnehem. mi shezzacha bedishshun mizbeach happenimi – nichnas venatal et hatteni, vehishtachava veyatza.

Mi shezzacha bedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shete nerot maaraviyyim dolkin. medashshen et hammizrachi, umanniach et hammaaravi dolek. shemmimmennu haya madlik et hammenora shel ben haarbayim. metzao shekkava, medashsheno umadliko mimmizbach haola. natal et hakkuz mimmaala sheniyya, vehishtachava veyatza.
2 Mi shezzacha bammachta, tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe hammizbeach, veriddan beshule hammachta, vehishtachava veyatza.

3 Mi shezzacha bakketoret, haya notel et habbazech mittoch hakkaf, venotno leohavo o likrovo. nitpazzer mimmennu letocho – notno lo bechofnav. umelammedim oto: heve zahir shemma tatchil mippanecha, shello tikkave.
Hitchil meraddedan veyotze. lo haya hammaktir maktir ad shehamemunne omer lo: haketer! veim haya kohen gadol, hamemunne omer lo: "ishi kohen gadol, haketer"!
Parshu haam, vehiktir vehishtachava veyatza.
Hadaran alach hechellu olim
b: Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lehishtachavot, shelosha ochazin bo: echad bimino, veechad bismolo, veechad baavanim tovot.
Vechevan sheshshama hamemunne kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze, higbiah lo et happarochet. nichnas, vehishtachava veyatza. nichnesu echav hakkohanim, hishtachavu veyatzu.

Bau veamdu al maalot haulam. amdu harishonim lidrom achehem hakkohanim, vachamishsha kelim beyadam: hatteni beyad echad, vehakkuz beyad echad, vehammachta beyad echad, vehabbazech beyad echad, vechaf vechissuyo beyad echad.
Uverchu et haam beracha achat. ella shebbammedina omrim otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha achat. bammikdash hayu omrim et hashshem kichtavo, uvammedina bechinnuyo.

Bammedina – hakkohanim nosim et yedehem keneged kitfehem, uvammikdash – al gabbe rashehen. chutz mikkohen gadol, sheen magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer: af kohen gadol magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem".
Bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaketir, haya ole bakkevesh, vehassegan bimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh, achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu.

Vehoshit lo harishon harosh veharegel, vesamach alehen, uzerakan. hoshit hashsheni larishon shete hayyadayim, notnan lechohen gadol, vesamach alehen, uzerakan. nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo. vechach hayu moshitin lo shear kol haevarin, vehu somech alehen vezorkan. uvizman shehu rotze – hu somech, vaacherim zorkin.
Ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach, mehechan hu matchil – mikkeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. natnu lo yayin lenassech.
Hassegan omed al hakkeren, vehassudarim beyado. shene kohanim omdin al shulchan hachalavim, ushete chatzotzrot beyadam. taku veheriu vetaku.

Bau veamdu etzel ben arza, echad mimino veechad missemolo. shacha lenassech, vehenif hassegan bassudarim, vehikkish ben arza batztziltzal, vedibberu haleviyyim bashshir. higgiu lapperek, taku, vehishtachavu haam. al kol perek – tekia, veal kol tekia – hishtachavaya. zehu seder hattamid laavodat bet elohenu, yehi ratzon sheyyibbane bimhera beyamenu, amen.

Hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrim bammikdash: bayyom harishon hayu omrim "laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve vah". bashsheni hayu omrim "gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kodsho". bishlishi hayu omrim "elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot". barvii hayu omrim "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia". bachamishi hayu omrim "hareninu lelohim uzzenu hariu lelohe yaakov". bashshishshi hayu omrim "Adonai malach geut lavesh lavesh vegomer". bashshabbat hayu omrim "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat" – mizmor shir leatid lavo, leyom shekkullo shabbat umenucha lechayye haolamim.
Hadaran alach bizman shekkohen gadol uselika la massechet tamid

a: Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash, bevet avtinas, uvevet hannitzotz, uvevet hammoked. vehaleviyyim beesrim veechad makom. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. arbaa, al arba pinnotav mittocho. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare haazara. arbaa, al arba pinnoteha mibbachutz. veechad belishkat hakkarban, veechad belishkat happarochet, veechad laachore vet hakkapporet:

Ish har habbayit haya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar, vaavukot dolkin lefanav, vechol mishmar sheeno omed, omer lo ish har habbayit, shalom alecha. nikkar shehu yashen, chovto vemaklo. ureshut haya lo lisrof et kesuto. vehem omrim, ma kol baazara. kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin, sheyyashen lo al mishmaro. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, paam achat matzu et achi imma yashen, vesarfu et kesuto:

Chamishsha shearim hayu lehar habbayit. shene shaare chulda min haddarom, meshammeshin kenisa vitzia. kifonos min hammaarav, meshammesh kenisa vitzia. tadi min hatztzafon, lo haya meshammesh kelum. shaar hammizrachi, alav shushan habbira tzura, shebbo chohen gadol hassoref et happara ufara vechol mesaadeha yotzim lehar hammishcha:

Shiva shearim hayu vaazara, shelosha vatztzafon ushelosha vaddarom veechad bammizrach. shebbaddarom, shaar haddelek. sheni lo, shaar habbechorot. shelishi lo, shaar hammayim. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor, ushete leshachot hayu lo, achat mimino veachat missemolo, achat lishkat pinchas hammalbish, veachat lishkat ose chavittin:

Veshebbatztzafon, shaar hannitzotz. uchemin achsadra haya, vaaliyya venuya al gabbav, shehakkohanim shomrim milmalan vehaleviyyim millemattan, ufetach haya lo lachel. sheni lo, shaar hakkarban. shelishi lo, bet hammoked:

Vearba leshachot hayu bevet hammoked, kekitonot petuchot litraklin, shetayim bakkodesh ushetayim bachol, verashe fispasin mavdilin ben kodesh lachol. ume hayu meshammeshot. maaravit deromit, hi hayta lishkat telae karban. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat ose lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit, bah ganzu vene chashmonay et avne hammizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan. tzefonit maaravit, bah yordim levet hattevila:
Shenayim shearim hayu levet hammoked, echad patuach lachel veechad patuach laazara. amar rabbi yehuda, ze shehaya fatuach laazara, pishpash katan haya lo, shebbo nichnasin livlosh et haazara:
Bet hammoked, kippa, uvayit gadol haya, mukkaf rovadin shel even, vezikne vet av yeshenim sham, umaftechot haazara beyadam, ufirche chehunna, ish kisto vaaretz:

Umakom haya sham, amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, veshalshelet shehammaftechot hayu teluyot bah. higgia zeman hanneila, higbiah et hattavla battabbaat venatal et hammaftechot min hashshalshelet, venaal hakkohen mibbifnim, uven levi yashen lo mibbachutz. gamar millinol, hechezir et hammaftechot lashshalshelet veet hattavla limkomah, natan kesuto aleha, yashen lo. era keri beachad mehem, yotze veholech lo vammesibba haholechet tachat habbira, vehannerot dolkim mikkan umikkan, ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bammesibba haholechet tachat hachel yotze veholech lo betadi:

Har habbayit haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma, rubbo min haddarom, sheni lo min hammizrach, shelishi lo min hatztzafon, miuto min hammaarav. mekom shehaya rov middato, sham haya rov tashmisho:

Kol hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veyotzin derech semol, chutz mimmi sheero davar, shehu makkif lismol. ma lecha makkif lismol, sheani avel, hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachamekka. sheani menudde, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbam vikarvucha, divre rabbi meir. amar lo rabbi yose, asitan keillu avru alav et haddin. ella, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbecha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha:

Lifnim mimmennu, soreg, gavoah asara tefachim. ushelosh esre feratzot hayu sham, shepperatzum malche yavan. chazru ugedarum, vegazru chenegdam shelosh esre hishtachavayot. lifnim mimmennu, hachel, eser ammot. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham. rum hammaala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma. kol hammaalot shehayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim vehashshearim shehayu sham, gavhan esrim amma, verachban eser ammot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim shehayu sham, hayu lahen delatot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, hayu lahen shekofot, chutz mishshaar tadi, shehayu sham shete avanim muttot zo al gav zo. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, nishtannu lihyot shel zahav, chutz mishshaar nikkanor, mippene shennaasa vahen nes. veyesh omrim, mippene shennechushtan matzhiv:
Kol hakketalim shehayu sham, hayu gevohim, chutz mikkotel hammizrachi, shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed berosh har hammishcha, umitkavven veroe vefitcho shel hechol bishat hazzayat haddam:

Ezrat hannashim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. vearba leshachot hayu vearba miktzooteha, shel arbaim arbaim amma. velo hayu mekorot. vechach hem atidim lihyot, shenneemar (Yechezkel 46), vayyotzieni el hechatzer hachitzona vayyaavireni el arbaat miktzoe hechatzer vehinne chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, bearbaat miktzoot hechatzer chatzerot keturot. veen keturot ella sheenan mekorot. ume hayu meshammeshot. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat hannezirim, sheshsham hannezirim mevashshelin et shalmehen, umegallechin et searan, umeshallechim tachat haddud. mizrachit tzefonit, hi hayta lishkat haetzim, sheshsham hakkohanim baale mumin matliin haetzim. vechol etz shennimtza vo tolaat, pasul meal gabbe hammizbeach. tzefonit maaravit, hi hayta lishkat metzoraim. maaravit deromit, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, sham hayu notnin yayin vashemen, hi hayta nikret lishkat bet shemanya. vachalaka hayta barishona, vehikkifuha chetzotzra, shehannashim root milmalan, vehaanashim millemattan, kede shello yehu meoravin. vachamesh esre maalot olot mittochah leezrat yisrael, keneged chamesh esre maalot shebbattehillim, shealehen haleviyyim omrim bashshir. lo hayu terutot, ella mukkafot kachatzi goren agulla:

Uleshachot hayu tachat ezrat yisrael, ufetuchot leezrat hannashim, sheshsham haleviyyim notnim kinnorot unevalim umetziltayim vechol kele shir. ezrat yisrael hayta orech mea amma usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. vechen ezrat kohanim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. verashe fispasin mavdilin ben ezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, maala hayta sham, ugevoha amma, vehadduchan natun aleha, uvah shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma. nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha meezrat yisrael shete ammot umechetza. kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. ushelosh esre hishtachavayot hayu sham. abba yose ven chanan omer, keneged shelosha asar shearim. shearim deromiyyim semuchim lammaarav, shaar haelyon, shaar haddelek, shaar habbechorot, shaar hammayim, velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim. shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch bechag. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, uvo hammayim mefakkim, vaatidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. uleummatan batztzafon semuchim lammaarav, shaar yechanya, shaar hakkarban, shaar hannashim, shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya, shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor. ushene fishpashim hayu lo, echad mimino veechad missemolo. ushenayim bamaarav, lo haya lahem shem:

Hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim. ala amma vechanas amma, ze hayesod. nimtza sheloshim al sheloshim. ala chamesh vechanas amma. ze hassovev. nimtza esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. mekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vashesh al esrim vashesh. mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim, amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vearba al esrim vearba, mekom hammaaracha. amar rabbi yose, mittechilla lo haya ella shemone veesrim al shemone veesrim, kones veole bemidda zo, ad shennimtza mekom hammaaracha esrim al esrim. ucheshealu vene haggola, hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav, kemin gamma, shenneemar (Yechezkel 43), vehaariel shetem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua. yachol sheeno ella shetem esre al shetem esre, keshehu omer (sham) el arbaat revaav, melammed shemmin haemtza hu moded shetem esre amma lechol ruach. vechut shel sikra chogro vaemtza, lehavedil ben haddamim haelyonim laddamim hattachtonim. vehayesod haya mehallech al pene chol hatztzafon veal pene chol hammaarav, veochel baddarom amma achat, uvammizrach amma echat:
Uvekeren maaravit deromit hayu shene nekavim, kemin shene chotamin dakkin, shehaddamim hannittanin al yesod maaravi veal yesod deromi, yordin bahen umitarvin baamma, veyotzin lenachal kidron:

Lematta varitzfa beotah hakkeren, makom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, shebbo yordin lashshit umenakkin oto. vechevesh haya lidromo shel mizbeach, sheloshim ushetayim al rochav shesh esre, urevuva hayta lo bemaaravo, sheshsham hayu notnim pesule chattat haof:

Echad avne hakkevesh veechad avne hammizbeach, mibbikat bet karem. vechofrin lematta mehabbetula, umeviim mishsham avanim shelemot, shello hunaf alehen barzel, shehabbarzel posel bingia. uvifgima lechol davar. nifgema achat mehen, hi fesula vechullan kesherot. umelabbenim otan paamayim bashshana, achat bappesach veachat bechag. vehahechol, paam achat, bappesach. rabbi omer, kol erev shabbat melabbenim oto vemappa mippene haddamim. lo hayu sadin otan bechafis shel barzel, shemma yigga veyifsol, shehabbarzel nivra lekatztzer yamav shel adam, vehammizbeach nivra lehaarich yamav shel adam, eno vadin sheyyunaf hamekatztzer al hammaarich:

Vetabbaot hayu litzfono shel mizbeach, shishsha sedarim shel arba arba, veyesh omrim, arbaa shel shesh shesh, shealehen shochatin et hakkodashim. bet hammitbachayim haya litzfono shel mizbeach, vealav shemona ammudim nannasin, ureviin shel erez al gabbehen, veunkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuin bahem, ushelosha sedarim hayu lechol echad veechad, shebbahem tolin. umafshitin al shulchanot shel shayish shebben haammudim:

Hakkiyyor haya ben haulam velammizbeach, umashuch kelappe haddarom. ben haulam velammizbeach, esrim ushetayim amma. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah amma. amma amma veroved shalosh, veamma amma veroved shalosh. vehaelyona, amma amma veroved arba. rabbi yehuda omer, haelyona, amma amma veroved chamesh:

Pitcho shel ulam, gavho arbaim amma, verachbo esrim amma. vechamesh malteraot shel milat hayu al gabbav. hattachtona odefet al happetach amma mizze veamma mizze. shellemala mimmenna odefet aleha amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtzet haelyona sheloshim amma. venidbach shel avanim haya ven kol achat veechat:

Uchelonasot shel erez hayu kevuin mikkatlo shel hechol lechatlo shel ulam, kede shello yivat. vesharsherot shel zahav hayu kevuot betikrat haulam, shebbahen pirche chehunna olin veroin et haatarot, shenneemar (Zecharya 6), vehaatarot tihye lechelem uletoviyya velidaya ulechen ben tzefanya lezikkaron behechal Adonai. gefen shel zahav hayta omedet al pitcho shel hechol, umudla al gabbe chelonasot. kol mi shehu mitnaddev ale, o gargir, o eshkol, mevi vetole vah. amar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, maase haya, venimnu aleha shelosh meot kohanim:

Pitcho shel hechol, gavho esrim amma verachbo eser ammot. vearba delatot hayu lo, shetayim bifnim ushetayim bachutz, sheneemar (Yechezkel 41), ushetayim delatot lahechol velakkodesh. hachitzonot niftachot letoch happetach lechassot avyo shel kotel, vehappenimiyyot niftachot letoch habbayit lechassot achar haddelatot, shekkol habbayit tuach bezahav, chutz meachar haddelatot. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch happetach hayu omdot, uchemin itzteramita hayu, venikpalot laachorehen, ellu shete ammot umechetza, veellu shete ammot umechetza, chatzi amma mezuza mikkan, vachatzi amma mezuza mikkan, shenneemar (sham), ushetayim delatot laddelatot shetayim musabbot delatot, shetayim ledelet echat ushete delatot laacheret:

Ushene fishpashin hayu lo lashshaar haggadol, echad batztzafon, veechad baddarom. shebbaddarom, lo nichnas bo adam meolam, vealav hu meforash al yede yechezkel, shenneemar (sham 44), vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo yavo vo ki Adonai elohe yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur. natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash, venichnas lehatta, umehatta lahechol. rabbi yehuda omer, betoch avyo shel kotel haya mehallech, ad shennimtza omed ben shene hashshearim, ufatach et hachitzonot mibbifnim veet happenimiyyot mibbachutz:

Usheloshim ushemona taim hayu sham, chamishsha asar batztzafon, chamishsha asar baddarom, ushemona bammaarav. shebbatztzafon veshebbaddarom, chamishsha al gabbe chamishsha, vachamishsha al gabbehem. veshebbammaarav, shelosha al gabbe shelosha, ushenayim al gabbehem. ushelosha fetachim hayu lechol echad veechad, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta min hassemol, veechad latta sheal gabbav. uvekeren mizrachit tzefonit hayu chamishsha fetachim, echad latta min hayyamin, veechad latta sheal gabbav, veechad lammesibba, veechad lappishpash, veechad lahechol:

Hattachtona, chamesh, veroved shesh. vehaemtzait, shesh, veroved sheva. vehaelyona, sheva, shenneemar (Melachim 1 6), hayyatzia hattachtona chamesh baamma rachbah vehattichona shesh baamma rachbah vehashshelishit sheva baamma rachba:

Umesibba hayta ola mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit lekeren tzefonit maaravit, shebbah hayu olim legaggot hattaim. haya ole bammesibba ufanav lammaarav. halach al kol pene hatztzafon, ad shehu maggia lammaarav. higgia lammaarav, vehafach panav laddarom. halach kol pene maarav ad shehu maggia laddarom. higgia laddarom, vehafach panav lammizrach. haya mehallech baddarom, ad shehu maggia lefitchah shel aliyya, sheppitchah shel aliyya patuach laddarom. uvefitchah shel aliyya hayu shene chelonasot shel erez, shebbahen hayu olin legaggah shel aliyya. verashe fispasin mavdilim baaliyya ben hakkodesh leven kodesh hakkodashim. velulin hayu fetuchin baaliyya levet kodesh hakkodashim, shebbahen hayu meshalshelin et haummanim betevot, kede shello yazunu enehen mibbet kadshe hakkodashim:

Vehahechol mea al mea, al rum mea. haotem shesh ammot, vegavho arbaim amma, amma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, vegova shel aliyya arbaim amma, veamma kiyyur, veammatayim bet dilfa, veamma tikra, veamma maaziva, veshalosh ammot maake, veamma kale orev, rabbi yehuda omer, lo haya chale orev ole min hammidda, ella arba ammot haya maake:

Mehammizrach lammaarav mea amma, kotel haulam chamesh, vehaulam achad asar, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho arbaim amma, amma teraksin, veesrim amma bet kodesh hakkodashim, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh. min hatztzafon laddarom shivim amma, kotel hammesibba chamesh, vehammesibba shalosh, kotel hatta chamesh, vehatta shesh, kotel hahechol shesh, vetocho esrim amma, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh, uvet horadat hammayim shalosh ammot, vehakkotel chamesh ammot. haulam odef alav chamesh esre amma min hatztzafon, vachamesh esre amma min haddarom, vehu haya nikra bet hachalifot, sheshsham gonzim et hassakkinim. vehahechol tzar meacharav, verachav millefanav, vedome laari, shenneemar (yeshaya 29), hoy ariel ariel kiryat chana david, ma haari tzar meacharav verachav millefanav, af hahechol tzar meacharav verachav millefanav:

Kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. min hammizrach lammaarav mea ushemonim vasheva, mekom derisat yisrael achat esre amma, mekom derisat hakkohanim achat esre amma, hammizbeach sheloshim ushetayim, ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushetayim amma, hahechol mea amma, veachat esre amma laachore vet hakkapporet:

Min hatztzafon laddarom mea usheloshim vechamesh, hakkevesh vehammizbeach shishshim ushetayim. min hammizbeach lattabbaot shemone ammot, mekom hattabbaot esrim vearba, min hattabbaot lashshulchanot arba, min hashshulchanot velannannasin arba. min hannannasin lechotel haazara shemone ammot, vehammotar ben hakkevesh lakkotel umekom hannannasin:

Shesh leshachot hayu vaazara, shalosh batztzafon veshalosh baddarom. shebbatztzafon, lishkat hammelach, lishkat happarva, lishkat hamedichim. lishkat hammelach, sham hayu notnim melach lakkarban. lishkat happarva, sham hayu molchin orot kadashim, veal gaggah haya vet hattevila lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim. lishkat hamedichin, sheshsham hayu medichin kirve hakkodashim. umishsham mesibba ola legag bet happarva:

Shebbaddarom, lishkat haetz, lishkat haggola, lishkat haggazit. lishkat haetz, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, lishkat kohen gadol, vehi hayta achore shetehen, vegag shelashtan shave. lishkat haggola, sham haya vor kavua, vehaggalgal natun alav, umishsham maspikim mayim lechol haazara. lishkat haggazit, sham hayta sanhedri gedola shel yisrael yoshevet vedana et hakkehunna, vechohen shennimtza vo fesul, lovesh shechorim umitattef shechorim, veyotze veholech lo. veshello nimtza vo fesul, lovesh levanim umitattef levanim, nichnas umeshammesh im echav hakkohanim. veyom tov hayu osim, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon hakkohen, vechach hayu omrim, baruch hammakom baruch hu, shello nimtza fesul bezaro shel aharon. uvaruch hu, shebbachar beaharon uvevanav laamod lesharet lifne Adonai bevet kadshe hakkodashim:
Mishna shammay omer: kol hannashim dayyayn sheatan. hillel omer: mippekida lifkida, vaafillu leyamim harebe.
Vachachamim omrim: lo kedivre ze, velo kedivre ze, ella meet leet memaetet al yad mippekida lifkida, umippekida lifkida memaetet al yad meet leet.
Kol ishsha sheyyesh lah veset — dayya sheatah, vehameshammeshet beedim — hare zo kifkida, umemaetet al yad meet leet veal yad mippekida lifkida.
Ketzad dayya sheatah? hayta yoshevet bammitta vaasuka bitharot, ufarsha veraata — hi temea vehen tehorot.
Af al pi sheamru, metammea meet leet, enah mona ella mishshaa sheraata.
Gemara may tameh deshammay? kasavar: haamed ishsha al chezkatah, veishsha bechezkat tehora omedet. vehillel? ki amar: haamed davar al chezkato — hecha delet leh reuta miggufeh, aval itteta
b: Kevan demiggufa kachazya — la amrinan okma achezkata.
Umay shena mimmikve? ditnan: mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser — kol teharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid — temeot.
Leshammay kashya lemafrea.
Lehillel kashya vadday, deillu meet leet shebbenidda tolin — lo ochlin velo sorfin, veillu hacha tumea vadday!
Hatam, mishshum deikka lememar: haamed tame al chezkato, veema lo taval. adderabba, haamed mikve al chezkato, veema lo chasar! hare chaser lefanecha!
Hacha name, hare dam lefanecha! hasheta hu dachazay. hacha name, hasheta hu dachasar!
Hachi hasheta? hatam ikka lememar: chasar vaata, chasar vaata. hacha mi ikka lememar: chazay vaata, chazay vaata? umay kusheya?! dilma haggas haggas chazeteh!
Hatam ikka tarte lereuta, hacha ikka chada lereuta.
Umay shena mechavit? ditnan: haya bodek et hechavit lihyot mafrish aleha teruma veholech, veachar kach nimtza chometz — kol shelosha yamim (harishonim) vadday,
Mikkan veelach — safek. kashya leshammay!
Hatam, mishshum deikka lememar: haamed tevel al chezkato, veemar lo nitkan. adderabba, haamed yayin al chezkato, veemar lo hechmitz!
Hare hechmitz lefanecha! hacha name, hare dam lefanecha! hasheta hu dachazay. hatam name, hasheta hu dehechmitz!
Hachi hasheta? hatam ikka lememar: hechmitz vaata, hechmitz vaata. hacha mi ikka lememar: chazay vaata, chazay vaata? umay kusheya?! dilma haggas haggas chazeteh!
Hatam ikka tarte lereuta, hacha ikka chada lereuta.
Uremi chavit ammikve: may shena hacha vadday, umay shena hacha safek?
Amar rabbi chanina missura: man tena chavit? rabbi shimon hi, dilgabbe mikve name sefeka meshavve leh.
Ditnan: mikve shennimdad venimtza chaser — kol hatteharot shennaasu al gabbav lemafrea, ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid, temeot.
Rabbi shimon omer: birshut harabbim tehorot, birshut hayyachid tolin.
